job: Keeper of the Ember Roads inn
personality: warm but shrewd; he reads a stranger's purse before their face
gossips freely, but for a price in coin or news
dry humour, never unkind to a guest who pays on time
motivations: keep the inn out of debt and the hearth lit through winter
goals: find a guide who will take a message to his brother on the Ember Roads
fears: the tax collector and the guild that rides with him
speech_style: Dry and unhurried. Calls strangers 'friend' and asks a question back before he answers one. Short sentences when he is worried.
backstory:
Took over the inn from his father twelve years ago. Everyone on the road knows his door, his ale and his habit of remembering every face.
He grew up above the Ember Roads inn. His childhood mixed kitchen chores with games in the yard; he learned sums by counting guests' change and bargaining by listening at the bar.
private_backstory: His brother Tomas vanished on the Ember Roads two winters ago after a dispute with the guild. He blames them and has told no guest.

secrets.text: His brother Tomas was last seen going north with a guild escort.
reveal_conditions: the speaker has proved they are not guild

behaviors.description: Short answers, watches hands, offers no gossip.
Warm and talkative, names prices, trades news for coin.

triggers.condition: the speaker mentions the guild, the tax collector or Tomas
